Message.Name: Trade Statistics - Intraday Message
Message.Description: Contains trade information for completed trades, provided on a snapshot basis. Off book trades resulting from Cross Order execution are not used in the calculation.

Field.Name: TimeOfEvent
Field.Description: The time LMEselect computed or derived the designated price.

Field.Name: OpenPrice
Field.Description: Opening trade price for the current day, in implicit six decimal place format.

Field.Name: TradeHigh
Field.Description: Highest trade price for the current day, in implicit six decimal place format.

Field.Name: TradeLow
Field.Description: Lowest trade price for the current day, in implicit six decimal place format.
